## Portsmouth vs Sheffield Utd Preview [...] ### Sheffield Utd

Sheffield United's probable shape is a 4-2-3-1. That is a change from their usual setup, as they have used it only once in their last ten matches. Patrick Bamford is set to play just behind Thomas Cannon, with Tahith Chong and Ben Brereton on the flanks. Kalvin Phillips is on the absentee list after missing the Lincoln game, but he should return alongside Sydie Peck, while Hamza Choudhury will be assessed after taking a knock in that match.

Formation: 4-2-3-1
